Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 26

“The wise should not unsettle the understanding of the ignorant who are attached to action, but, acting in a disciplined way, should encourage them in all their work.”

A caution against destabilizing people with truths they cannot yet use. Krishna asks the wise to support others' work rather than dismantle the motives currently holding it up.
